text:
Is this my ancestor's resting place?
Never have I imagined this crypt to be like this.
zh:
这就是我先祖的安息之地吗？
我从未想过这座墓穴竟是这般模样。

text:
My dear Miriam. 
You were my guiding light in the darkest hours.
zh:
我亲爱的米里亚姆。
在最黑暗的时刻，你曾是指引我的明光。

text:
But this time, my mind is imprisoned in darkness.
There is no longer a guiding light for me.
zh:
但这一次，我的心智被囚禁在黑暗之中。
再没有明光指引我了。

text:
I feel my bond to this world fade away.
Is my body finally released from this curse?
zh:
我感到自己与这个世界的联系正在消散。
我的躯体终于从这诅咒中解脱了吗？

text: You, who broke my curse, shall receive an ancient weapon of my family.
zh: 打破我诅咒之人啊，你将获得我家族的一件古老武器。

text: A path will open as the #:king:# feels the #:warmth of the fire:#.
zh: 当#:国王:#感受到#:炉火的温暖:#时，一条道路将会开启。
